notes: A4 has no JSON Schema; the enumerator in verify-contracts.mjs is the check, and this listing is its input. task_dirs are the entries at or above the floor (state parses, orchestrator.created is a full non-midnight timestamp, task.title present). inventory_only covers the pre-floor T00:00:00Z created value, an unparseable state, a state with no created field, and the two legacy type dirs (bug-fixes/, mockups/) which are inventory-only regardless of content. README.md and notes.txt under a type dir and the dot-prefixed .archive dir and .mockups.json file are non-task children and must be ignored by the enumerator - they appear in neither list.
